finding: Reforged world-item persistence can maintain independently integrity-protected primary and backup generations, reject tampered generations before deserialization, and atomically restore both primary data and its integrity sidecar from a validated backup.
world_state_impact: primary and backup item-state generations are independently authenticated and recovery restores authoritative bytes plus integrity metadata
assumptions: SHA-256 sidecars are Reforged infrastructure only
Backup rotation requires a valid primary and valid primary integrity record
Native MajorMUD journal and checksum formats remain unresolved
fallback: reject recovery with InvalidDataException and preserve both generations when neither independently validates
tests: tampered primary recovery from validated backup
restored primary data and sidecar verification
